title: Matrix-Chain Multiplication
statement:
Use interval DP to minimize scalar multiplications in an ordered product of matrices.

Input
n, then d0 d1 … dn. Matrix i has dimensions d(i−1)×di. Multiplying an a×b matrix by a b×c matrix costs a·b·c scalar multiplications.

Output
Print the minimum total cost.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 400. Every dimension is in [1,100000].
